{{Quote|No, no. I just used a decoy, is all. The real thermal detonator is right...|Trelek during a fight|<ref name="DC">''[[Dangerous Covenants]]''</ref>}}
'''Kasso Trelek''' was a [[Weequay/Legends|Weequay]] demolitions expert who worked freelance with [[N1-FEX]] and [[Tera (Human)|Tera]]. Trelek once spoke about how to run a [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenary]] band after ten years of experience.<ref name="DC" />

At one point, he and his team were at a [[Spaceport/Legends|spaceport]] when they were attacked by [[Vols]]. During the fight, Trelek threw what he thought was a decoy [[Thermal detonator/Legends|thermal detonator]], but it was a real one, and blew up the cantina they were in. Tera then called for them to leave.<ref name="DC" />

==Behind the scenes==
Kasso Trelek appears in the opening story in [[Fantasy Flight Games]]' [[roleplaying game]] sourcebook ''[[Dangerous Covenants]]''.<ref name="DC" />
